name: Admin Language t() function Override
description: Forces the interface (t()) language to English (or a per-user choice) on admin and configured wildcard paths regardless of the URL language prefix, by decorating the string_translation service.
project_description:
Forces a specific interface language layout (e.g., English or a custom user-defined preference) on designated administrative paths and node translation edit forms, while leaving underlying content dataset values entirely untouched.

Managing multilingual environments in Drupal often poses a distinct workflow issue for content editors and administrators. When working on a localized node edit path (such as /fr-ca/node/123/edit), Drupal's core routing naturally translates the entire administrative interface layout into that translation's language. The Admin Language t() function Override module resolves this by decorating Drupal's low-level string translation manager (string_translation). By targeting string rendering directly instead of disrupting routing stacks or the global language environment, it enforces the desired interface language on specified admin tools while completely preserving the true content language context, so multilingual field datasets load, display, and save in their correct language.

The module decorates the string_translation service with AdminStringTranslationDecorator, appends an "Administration Language Preference" selector to the user edit form (stored in per-user user.data), and exposes a settings form at /admin/config/regional/admin-language-t-function-override where an administrator toggles the override and lists the wildcard path patterns (default: /admin/*, /*/edit, /*/delete, /*/revisions, /*/layout, /*/translations) on which the interface language is forced.
